claims.claim_text: A method of content handling in an edge region of a content delivery network, the edge region comprising a set of peer machines, wherein each peer machine of the set comprises a processor, and a cache, comprising: receiving a request at a first one of the peer machines, the request having associated therewith a hostname having a value that points to peer machines in the edge region to facilitate load balancing, the value configured for use as a cache key, the request being one of a set of requests associated with the hostname received in the edge region; in response to receiving the request, hashing the cache key that includes the value to create a hashed value that also points to one or more other peer machines in the set of peer machines; based on the hashed value, forwarding the request to at least one other peer machine pointed to by the hashed value; and at the other peer machine, using the hashed value as a cache key for responding to the request; wherein hashing of the cache key and forwarding of the request facilitate spreading of the set of requests associated with the hostname across the set of peer machines.
The method as described in claim 1 wherein the value is a serial number.
The method as described in claim 1 wherein the set of peer machines are connected to one another across a back-end interface in the edge region.
The method as described in claim 3 wherein hashing the cache key spreads the value across the set of peer machines.
The method as described in claim 1 further including configuring each of the peer machines of the set of peer machines to perform the hashing of the cache key and forwarding of the request.
The method as described in claim 1 wherein the set of peer machines comprise a tier of a cache hierarchy.
The method as described in claim 1 wherein the request is associated with a content object.
The method as described in claim 7 wherein, based on a number of requests per a given time period, the content object is defined as cold content.
The method as described in claim 8 wherein the other peer machine serves the cold content and caches it in its cache.
The method as described in claim 9 wherein the cold content is spread across the set of peer machines.

patent_title: Content delivery network (CDN) cold content handling
